personality_one_liner: A high-performance dark-first tactical proxy tunneling app with hacker-grade neon green accents, real-time ping monitors, SSH/SOCKS5 payload configs, and Indonesian localization.

spacing.rule: Generous tactical spacing with strict bottom safe area padding and sticky bottom action bar.

do's: Use solid dark tactical surfaces with high contrast neon borders
Keep latency badges and connection rings crisp and readable
dont's: Avoid heavy blur or glassmorphism which reduces clarity in tactical utility apps

screens.name: Home / Tunnel Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central control panel featuring the big neon connect/disconnect button, live status ring, duration timer, speed meter, and active server summary.

states.empty: Belum ada server dipilih. Pilih server dari daftar untuk mulai tunneling.
states.error: Koneksi gagal. Periksa konfigurasi SSH/SOCKS5 atau jaringan Anda.

screens.layout: Tactical status header, central glowing neon connect ring with live pulse animation, live download/upload speed gauges, quick server switcher card, and sticky bottom navigation.

screens.name: Server List
screens.purpose: Directory of seeded and user-added high-speed SSH/SOCKS5 proxy servers with real-time ping latencies and region flags.

states.empty: Belum ada server. Ketuk tombol '+' di kanan atas untuk menambah server baru.
states.error: Gagal memuat daftar server. Ketuk untuk mencoba lagi.

screens.layout: Search bar with protocol filters (SSH, SOCKS5, HTTP), server cards with live ping status indicators, region tags, and add-server floating action button.

screens.name: Config Editor (Payload & SSH)
screens.purpose: Advanced proxy tunneling configuration editor for host, port, authentication, and custom HTTP payloads.
screens.layout: Segmented protocol switcher, input fields for Host, Port, Username, Password, and multi-line Payload editor with test and save actions.

screens.name: Connection Logs
screens.purpose: Real-time terminal-style log output stream showing SSH handshake, AUTH, SOCKS5 tunnel bind, and data transmission events.

states.empty: Belum ada log aktivitas. Hubungkan VPN untuk melihat log koneksi.

screens.layout: Monospace terminal log viewer with color-coded info, success, and error lines, clear buffer button, and export logs action.

screens.name: Utilities & IP Checker
screens.purpose: Network tools including real-time speed test (Ping, Download, Upload) and IP spoofing checker showing virtual location and ISP.

states.empty: Ketuk 'Mulai Tes' untuk mengukur performa jaringan.
states.error: Gagal terhubung ke server tes kecepatan.

screens.layout: IP spoofing card with virtual flag, ISP, and latency metrics; speed test gauges with start test button and historical results log.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete 'RIYANMEE PROXY' React Native Expo app in Indonesian as specified in the problem statement.
Ensure all UI text is entirely in Indonesian (e.g., 'Hubungkan', 'Putuskan', 'Kecepatan', 'Server', 'Log', 'Pengaturan', 'Pengujian IP').
Implement Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility) with deep obsidian backgrounds (#0A0F0D), neon green brand primary (#00FF66), and high-contrast tactical cards.

Provide interactive screens for Home (connect button with status ring, live duration timer, live speed meter), Server List (demo servers + add server modal), Config Editor (SSH/SOCKS5/HTTP payloads + import/export), Connection Logs (terminal view), and Speed Test / IP Checker.
Follow all safety rules: touch targets >= 44x44pt, safe area padding at screen root, sticky bottom CTA with scroll padding, no banned colors (no blue/purple/indigo), and zero emojis in system UI.
